integrity: Contains complete reproducible finite enumeration, independent direct-deletion and inverse-insertion implementations, and recorded successful output. No external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: No bound on maxima for n > 8, no multiset-deck extremal classification, and no multi-deletion theorem is asserted. The finite certificate has been checked through its stated range; independent validation and exhaustive priority review are outstanding.
scientific_scope: Unordered pairs of permutations and distinct standardized exactly-one-deletion descendants, completely classified for 3 <= n <= 8; the extremal 2413/3142 four-block construction is valid for all n >= 4 as a lower bound.
title: Extremal distinct-deletion collisions for permutation words through length eight
